The '''Quake Shelter 14-K''' was a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] shelter located on the [[Frinn Mesa]] of [[Makeb]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] it was taken over by the [[InterStellar Regulators]] and was used by [[Kazac]] to hold their captive [[Lemda Avesta]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quake Shelter 14-K appears as an area on Makeb in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
